title: Meet Ren — What Cloud Really Is

blocks.heading: STUDENT MODE · LESSON 1 OF 10
blocks.board_text:
Student Mode = cloud literacy BEFORE the console.

Today:
• Who Ren is and how she teaches
• Cloud = rent, not own
• Why this mode exists

No AWS console today. Board + voice only.
blocks.ren_voice: I am Ren. I spent years in cloud at top companies, then left because schools and courses were not making people job-ready. This Student Mode is short on purpose — ten lessons of fundamentals, then you earn the console in Professional Mode. Today: what cloud actually is.

blocks.heading: CLOUD = RENT, NOT OWN
blocks.board_text:
Cloud computing = using computers, storage, and software over the internet that someone else owns and maintains.

Like electricity: you do not buy a power plant. You connect, use, and pay for what you used.

Big providers: AWS · Azure · Google Cloud
blocks.ren_voice: Cloud means you rent technology over the internet instead of buying servers for your office. You never touch a physical machine. You pay for what you use. AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud own the data centers. That rent-versus-own shift is the whole foundation.

check_question.question: In one sentence — what makes cloud different from buying your own servers?
check_question.ren_response_if_correct: Yes — you rent instead of own. That changes money, speed, and who fixes the hardware.
check_question.ren_response_if_incorrect: Think rent versus buy. Cloud is renting someone else's computers over the internet.

blocks.heading: WHY THIS MODE COMES FIRST
blocks.board_text:
College often jumps to buttons before mental models.
Result: people click without knowing why the bill exists.

Rebon order:
1) Understand the problem cloud solves
2) Then touch the console in Professional Mode
blocks.ren_voice: I will not throw you into the console on day one. First you need a mental model. When you later open AWS, every service will map to a business problem — not a random menu.

check_question.question: Why do we delay the console in Student Mode?
check_question.ren_response_if_correct: Correct — fundamentals first so console clicks have meaning.
check_question.ren_response_if_incorrect: Because clicking without a model creates button-pushers, not engineers.

blocks.heading: JUNIOR TRAP
blocks.board_text:
Trap: memorizing service names with no picture of rent vs own.
Habit: always ask — what problem does this solve for the business?
blocks.ren_voice: Juniors memorize EC2, S3, VPC like vocabulary lists. Useless under pressure. Habit: every concept must answer what business pain it removes.

blocks.heading: LOCK IT IN
blocks.board_text:
• Cloud = rent infrastructure over the internet
• Student Mode = literacy before console
• Next: why companies actually pay for cloud
blocks.ren_voice: Lock it: cloud is rent, not own. Ten short lessons. Console comes after you earn it.

lesson_summary.ren_voice: Lesson 1 done. You know the deal.

doubt_session.ren_opening: Any doubt on rent versus own?
